---
name: notes
description: Keep meeting notes in notes/ as dated Markdown files. Use when the user asks to take, find or summarise notes.
---

# Notes

Notes live in `notes/`, one file per meeting, named `YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md`.

- To take notes, create the file and write the agenda, the decisions and the follow-ups as three sections.
- To find notes, run `scripts/find.sh <word>` and show the matching lines.
- To summarise, read the files the user names and list the decisions first.

Keep the user's wording for decisions; do not paraphrase them.
